items.label: Premium Quality
items.value: Crafted with top layer cowhide leather and accented with high-quality silver hardware, this women’s handbag is designed to withstand the test of time. The dark brown interior polyester lining adds luxury to the overall design.

items.label: Organized Interior
items.value: The leather purse comes with a spacious room with multi pockets, a middle zipper compartment inside, and 1 zip pocket and 2 slots, the medium size tote bag keeps you organized on-the-go. It also features a rear zippered pocket for easy access to small items.

items.label: Versatile Design
items.value: The genuine leather handbags have sturdy top handles and a detachable long shoulder strap, offering multiple ways to carry it. Top handle, shoulder or cross-body. The top handle is 7.48in high; the long shoulder strap is about 45.66in-51.57in long.

items.label: Fashionable and Classic
items.value: Available in 7 classic colors, this satchel handbag is suitable for different occasions. Whether you're traveling, working, dating, or shopping, this hobo bag is a casual versatile accessory that adds a touch of fashion, and creativity to your look.

items.label: Perfect Size
items.value: Measuring (L)12.99 x (H)10.62 x (W)4.33in and weighing 2.51 pounds, the tote purse is the perfect size for everyday. See more details in the product description to make the perfect purchase.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: daily casual everyday work travel shopping

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Clean with a soft, dry cloth. Store in a cool, dry place. Avoid direct sunlight.
